'''Czesław Strumiłło''' (17 February 1930 – 30 September 2018)<ref>[http://nekrologi.wyborcza.pl/0,11,,430901,Czes%C5%82aw-Strumi%C5%82%C5%82o-nekrolog.html Czesław Strumiłło] {{in lang|pl}}</ref> was a Polish [[chemical engineering|chemical engineer]], a founder of a [[scientific theory]] in the field of drying processes and a former rector of the [[Lodz University of Technology]].

In 1952 he graduated from the Faculty of Chemistry, Lodz University of Technology. In 1960 he obtained the Doctor of Science degree, in 1966 his postdoctoral scientific qualifications and associate professor and professor degrees in 1974, and 1981, respectively.<ref>Ewa Chojnacka, Zbigniew Piotrowski, Ryszard Przybylski (red.), Lodz University of Technology Professors 1945–2005 (Profesorowie Politechniki Łódzkiej 1945–2005), ''[http://www.wydawnictwa.p.lodz.pl The Technical University Press]'', Łódź, 2006, pages 242–243</ref>

He is an ''honoris causa'' doctor of the [[Strathclyde University]] in Great Britain, Lodz University of Technology<ref>Katarzyna Osińska, [http://www.p.lodz.pl/nauka,item405,Doktorzy_honoris_causa_PL_w_latach_1996-2000_,doktoraty_honoris_causa_index.htm Honoris Causa Doctors of Lodz University of Technology] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150418135732/http://www.p.lodz.pl/nauka%2Citem405%2CDoktorzy_honoris_causa_PL_w_latach_1996-2000_%2Cdoktoraty_honoris_causa_index.htm |date=18 April 2015 }}, Dział Nauki, Lodz University of Technology, Łódź</ref> and [[University of West Hungary]]. 
He is an ordinary member of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Polish Academy of Sciences Ordinary Members|url=http://www.instytucja.pan.pl/index.php/czonkowie-pan/rzeczywici#4-wydzia%C5%82-iv|publisher=Polish Academy of Sciences|accessdate=13 March 2015}}</ref> 
He was twice selected a member of the [[State Committee for Scientific Research]], in 1993–96 he was the Vice Chairperson of this Committee. 
He is the Vice President of the Lodz Institute of the Polish Academy of Sciences, a vice chairperson of the Committee on Chemical and Process Engineering of the Polish Academy of Sciences,<ref>{{cite web|title=Committee on Chemical and Process Engineering – Members list|url=http://www.kichip.pan.pl/pl/skad|publisher=Polish Academy of Sciences|accessdate=18 March 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150402094912/http://www.kichip.pan.pl/pl/skad|archive-date=2 April 2015|url-status=dead}}</ref> a Polish representative in Drying Working Party and Science Advisory Committee European Federation of Chemical Engineering. In 1995 he received the title of the Honorary Professor of the [[Tianjin University]] in China.
From 1984 to 1987 he was a Vice Rector, and from 1987 to 1990 the Rector of the Lodz University of Technology. From 1993 to 1999 he was the Dean of the Faculty of Process and Environmental Engineering.

==Scientific activity==

His scientific activity is connected with heat and mass transfer in the processes of [[distillation]], [[evaporation]], drying and [[fluidization]]. He is an author of the first Polish monograph in the field of drying.<ref>{{cite web|title=Fundamentals of Theory and Techniques of Drying|url=http://150.254.171.193/ipac20/ipac.jsp?session=138A680851RY2.3052&profile=bgpp&uri=link=3100019~!5575~!3100001~!3100002&aspect=subtab13&menu=search&ri=1&source=~!bpp&term=Podstawy+teorii+i+techniki+suszenia+%2F+Czes%C5%82aw+Strumi%C5%82%C5%82o.&index=ALTITLE|publisher=Wydawnictwa Naukowo-Techniczne|accessdate=18 March 2015}}</ref> His scientific achievements include 250 publications, 7 handbooks and monographs related to chemical engineering and process engineering. He has promoted 15 doctors of science.<ref>Małgorzata Trocha, [http://www.p.lodz.pl/main,item5869,Jubileusz_Profesora_Czeslawa_Strumillo_,wydarzenia_specjalne_index.htm Jubileusz prof. Czesława Strumiłło] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150402153612/http://www.p.lodz.pl/main%2Citem5869%2CJubileusz_Profesora_Czeslawa_Strumillo_%2Cwydarzenia_specjalne_index.htm |date=2 April 2015 }}, p.lodz.pl</ref>
